questionText: Given that I is 400 N and moves a distance of 10 m while II is 100 N and moves a distance of 5 m, calculate: (α) work output; (β) work input; (γ) efficiency.
modelAnswer: (α) Work output = Load x distance = 100 * 5 = 500 J; (β) Work input = Effort x distance = 400 * 10 = 4000 J; (γ) Efficiency = (Work output / Work input) x 100% = (500 / 4000) * 100 = 12.5%[cite: 3].

questionText: Describe the water cycle.
modelAnswer: Water evaporates from water bodies into the atmosphere, where it condenses into clouds and falls back to the earth's surface as rain (precipitation). This then flows back into water bodies and is taken up by plants which transpire to give off water vapour.

questionText: Explain how leaching interrupts the nitrogen cycle.
modelAnswer: During heavy rainfall, nitrates are washed out of the root zone, preventing plants from taking them in and interrupting the return of nitrogen as nitrites.

questionText: Explain how the removal of leguminous plants interrupts the nitrogen cycle.
modelAnswer: It removes nitrogen-fixing bacteria, preventing the conversion of atmospheric nitrogen to ammonia and denying the soil of nitrates.
